scope: Generated parser control for the ODA-defined AC1021 TABLE cell alignment RS field, which is present on the two metric-source cells with unresolved CadValue cursor candidates.

authority.specification: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.96.1, pp. 230-232
authority.field: cell alignment, RS (raw little-endian 16-bit), selected by override mask 0x01
authority.sequence: cell override flag BL, virtual edge RC, selected alignment RS, separate R2007+ unknown BL, CadValue flags/type/payload, unit BL and detached format/value TV strings

implementation.change: For the exact AC1021 text-cell override mask 0x01 profile, retain the ODA raw-RS alignment value, mark only values 1-9 semantically complete, and keep nonzero edge/virtual-edge flags incomplete. Other AC1021 cell override masks remain incomplete.
implementation.generatedFrame: The existing from-scratch AC1021 one-cell TABLE vector emits alignment value 5 with putRawShort16, then the separate unknown BL, CadValue flags/type/integer payload, unit and detached empty strings. No DWG/DXF fixture file is written.

assertions: frame builds from scratch with raw little-endian RS alignment value 5
parse completes semantic content for the exact AC1021 text-cell mask 0x01 profile
cursor lands exactly at tableDataEndBit after the following CadValue

peerReview.observation: The peer calls ReadBitShort for cell alignment, while ODA specifies raw RS. Its semantic decode is not independent physical-span proof for these cells.
peerReview.disposition: Do not use peer table values to justify changing the libdxfrw alignment decoder or to claim the physical type-48 cursor issue is resolved.

physicalSource.observation: The two first candidate failures remain row 8/column 0 at body bit 278726 for TABLE 0x2856e and row 9/column 0 at body bit 312907 for TABLE 0x2a974. Both local traces report override mask 0x01. After this parser change, both traces still reach the same undocumented data type 48 candidates; this slice neither fixes nor qualifies those physical TABLE bodies.

physicalReadback.result: The same two type-48 candidates remain at the recorded body bits; no broader TABLE support is inferred.

remainingAction: Build an independent physical source-span walk for the preceding override/body fields and reconcile the remaining cursor difference before any production parser change. No support claim is promoted.
